europe_now.title: Russian attacks on Kyiv
europe_now.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes hit Kyiv over multiple consecutive days, resulting in multiple casualties including among rail workers. The attacks have significantly escalated security concerns within the capital region.

sources.headline: Russian strike hits rail workers in new deadly attacks on Kyiv
Ukraine updates: Russia hits Kyiv for sixth straight day

europe_now.title: EU suspends Brazilian meat imports
europe_now.summary: The European Union has suspended certain meat imports from Brazil due to growing concerns over antibiotic compliance. The decision underscores stricter regulatory enforcement by European authorities on external agricultural products.

sources.headline: EU suspends Brazilian meat imports over antibiotic compliance concerns

top_stories.title: Death of Édouard Balladur
top_stories.summary: Former French Prime Minister Édouard Balladur has passed away at the age of 97. He was a prominent figure in French politics who previously vied for the presidency and served under President François Mitterrand.

sources.headline: 🔴 Former French prime minister Édouard Balladur dies at 97
Former French PM Édouard Balladur, once defeated by ally Jacques Chirac, dies at 97

top_stories.title: French-Swedish Defense Cooperation
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron traveled to Sweden to solidify bilateral defense arrangements. The leaders sealed a substantial multi-billion euro frigate agreement to enhance European security ties.

sources.headline: Macron seals €4.3-bn French frigate deal in Sweden
